Hating something new doesnt make you cool. Dont be fooled by retarded comments like "JuSt GeT LeFt4DeAd"
Game is awesome, runs smoothly, you can have a lot of fun with your friends, it has a more customizable approach to older games. We all played the L4D games we loved them. This game deserves some love too.

this isn't a left 4 dead game i don't know people keep comparing this to left 4 dead like this game isn't called left 4 dead 3, so I will give you my honest opinion non this game. Now if you look at this game as just a zombie in it of itself and your not comparing it to left 4 dead franchise this game is pretty fun. They give a huge selections of guns to choose from which is pretty dope, a nice selection of melee weapons to use, a bunch of ways to customize your weapons too. They have weapon skins that you can potentially unlock which are free you just gotta get lucky with unlocking them, and you can customize your characters too you just gotta get lucky with unlocking them. There are some skins that do cost money to unlock but that's because of a DLC. Now lets talk about the weapons, they give you a fairly decent amount of attachments you can use on your guns there just scattered around the maps you just have to get lucky with finding them, and the attachments come in different rarity's too as the game progresses. Oh and there's also decks that you can build to help you through the game and don't worry ill explain what those are, as you play levels and beat them you gain in game currency which you can then use to unlock a bunch of random cards and those cards with give you some kinda of boost, for instance there's a card that says i will be able to carry 50% more ammo and i can stack on another card that says i can carry 15% more ammo and have 5% reload speed, and you can carry 15 cards in a deck. I currently have a melee deck, a gunner deck, a medic deck, a shotgun deck, and a sniper deck. Also I'm constantly editing those decks because I'm unlocking new and better cards. Overall this game is just a blast, me and my friends like to play this on the 2nd hardest difficulty because its a challenge for us, I encourage people to give this a shot

This game wanted to be Left 4 Dead so badly, but it falls short in almost every way imaginable. There's a great video on YouTube called "Back 4 Blood proves Valve carried Left 4 Dead" that explains why this game just can't match Left 4 Dead. From terrible AI (both survivor and enemy) to reduced features, to overall lack of polish, this game feels like the "We have blank at home" meme for Left 4 Dead.
Mediocre attempt a left 4 dead successor. If can get it for really cheap you could have some fun otherwise just get Left 4 dead 2 or WWZ.
